variable_coverage.construction: E_IMPDUM_t = 1 when the paper-defined estimated impairment is nonzero; construct the annual GDWL reduction from t−1 to t, applying the 5% of beginning GDWL in the pre-142 fit beginning-goodwill threshold and the negative-SPI condition. The fit also applies the positive-beginning-goodwill and segment-divestiture screens.

Compute GTA_{t−1}=GDWL_{t−1}/AT_{t−1} and ROA_{t−1}=OIADP_{t−1}/average AT_{t−1}; IMPI_{t−1}=+1 if GTA>10% and ROA<0, −1 if GTA<5% and ROA>5%, otherwise 0. The paper does not define the average-AT endpoints.
Compute BTM_{t−1}=CEQ_{t−1}/(PRCC_F_{t−1}×CSHO_{t−1}) at the end of year t−1 and set BTMG1_{t−1}=1[BTM_{t−1}>1].

design_coverage.reason: Eq. (1) names the intercept and two indicators, and Table 3 Panel A does not report a weight variable or weighting procedure; no distinct weight input is described.

implementation_issues.description: ROA_{t−1} is defined using OIADP_{t−1}/average AT, but the paper does not state the averaging endpoints or date convention. This changes the IMPI classification near its thresholds and leaves the raw AT lookback beyond the t−1 predictor unresolved.

The divestiture screen uses a decline in “the number of segments” but gives no segment source, operating/geographic scope, segment counting rule or exact annual-date alignment. COMPSEG.WRDS_SEGMERGED is only a candidate source, not a verified semantic match.

Table 3 identifies conditional logit and firm-level clustering but does not separately describe the conditioning/fixed-effect groups, exact firm cluster identifier or implementation details; the fitted sample N is also not reported.

The Compustat/CRSP intersection requires an effective-dated firm/security link and common-stock restriction, but the paper does not state the linking product/criteria, accepted CCM link flags, common-stock SHRCD values or the exact date used to apply them. These choices can change the estimation population.

The assessment routes to current local Compustat/CRSP tables while retaining the 1996–2011 study design. The authors’ contemporaneous extraction vintage and any historical vendor revisions are not identified; current table probes do not quantify vintage differences.

evidence.quote: Our primary sample employs common stocks from the intersection of the Compustat fundamental annual database and the CRSP stock return database from 1996 to 2011.
evidence.description: Primary annual Compustat/CRSP intersection and stated study window.

evidence.quote: Consequently, the pre-SFAS 142 period in our sample is from 1996 to 2000, and the postSFAS 142 period is from 2004 to 2011.
evidence.description: Pre/post baseline years and excluded transition period context.

evidence.quote: we limit our sample to firm-years with a positive goodwill balance on Compustat at the beginning of the year.
evidence.description: Beginning-goodwill sample restriction.

evidence.quote: In the pre-SFAS 142 period, we define the estimated goodwill impairment as the reduction in the goodwill balance during the year if (i) the reduction exceeds a 5% threshold relative to the beginning goodwill balance and (ii) the firm also reports negative special items (SPI) that are at least as large as the reduction in goodwill.
evidence.description: Pre-period estimated impairment definition and Compustat components.

evidence.quote: Under the SFAS 142 regime, there is no goodwill amortization, and so we replace the 5% threshold with a 0% threshold.
evidence.description: Post-period threshold in the frozen baseline definition.

evidence.quote: We then exclude observations with both a decline in the number of segments and a reduction in the goodwill balance from our sample.
evidence.description: Possible-divestiture screen.

evidence.quote: We set missing GDWLIP to zero for firms with a positive goodwill balance.
evidence.description: Actual Compustat impairment missing-value rule.

evidence.quote: E_IMPDUMt (IMPDUMt) is a dummy variable that is equal to one if firms have nonzero E_GDWLIP (GDWLIP) in year t and zero otherwise.
evidence.description: Definition of estimated and Compustat dependent-variable indicators.

evidence.quote: GTAt-1 is GDWL divided by total assets (AT) at the end of year t-1.
evidence.description: GTA numerator/denominator and end-of-year t−1 date.

evidence.quote: ROAt-1 is operating income after depreciation (OIADP) in year t-1 divided by average total assets (AT).
evidence.description: ROA numerator and the source’s unspecified average-assets denominator.

evidence.quote: IMPIt-1 is equal to one for observations with GTAt-1>10% and ROAt-1 < 0, minus one for observations with GTAt-1 < 5% and ROAt-1 > 5% and zero otherwise.
evidence.description: IMPI indicator thresholds and three-way values.

evidence.quote: BTMt-1 is book value of equity (CEQ) divided by market value of equity (PRCC_f*CSHO) at the end of year t-1.
evidence.description: Book-to-market inputs and date.

evidence.quote: BTMG1t-1 is an indicator variable that is equal to one if BTMt-1 is greater than one and zero otherwise.
evidence.description: BTMG1 threshold.

evidence.quote: Panel A reports conditional logit regressions of Eq. (1) estimated at firm clusters.
evidence.description: Conditional-logit estimator and firm-level cluster statement; the text does not separately state a fixed-effect group implementation or cluster key.

evidence.quote: Numbers in the parentheses are zstatistics.
evidence.description: Table 3 inference display.
